elements.name: Rectangle 236
elements.text:
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY
Operational efficiency delivered through disciplined branch reduction and cost management…
















Branch reductions outpaced market, generating meaningful structural savings
Expenses kept below inflation, reflecting consistent cost discipline
~1,500 frontline salesforce roles reduction over last 5 years (-40%) without process and digital automation

elements.name: Rectangle 2592
elements.text:
STAGNANT GROWTH
…but overall growth remains flat and below market limiting top-line growth potential

















Client base flat, despite recent attrition improvements
Revenue growth driven by Mortgage, auto lending and change of reference rate from 4.5% to 8%, net with cost discipline rather than underlying volume expansion, while market growth continued to outpace SBM
